what: College split: is there a rail / barrier at the top of the bank along the northbound road's inner edge? (the southbound inner edge as the control)

frame.what: Lake Murray engine frame = data/centerline.local.json: x east, z north (m); y = NAVD88 - 100.8
frame.projection: shrub_heights.Track (the lm-shrub tool's own code, imported): UTM EPSG 6340 <-> EPSG:4326 by pyproj, x = (lon - lon0) * m_lon, z = (lat - lat0) * m_lat, WGS84 series at lat0; the same as job1_college_lidar.py
frame.tops_npz_frame: x, z = this frame (shrub_heights.Track.to_local of E, N); E, N = UTM EPSG 6340
frame.station_offset: v = the centreline vertex whose tangent foot is nearest (|along| smallest of the 4 nearest); offset_m = (p - P_v) . n_v, + = left of travel (v increasing) = west on College northbound (job1_college_lidar.py offset_doc; college_edges.json offset_sign); n_v checked against college_xsec.lidar.g10.json nx, nz to 5.0e-07
frame.centreline_md5_note: centerline.local.json of f0c35e1f = the lm-shrub job's = lm-round2's (md5 identical)

method.edges: [from file] nb_inner_smooth_m / sb_inner_smooth_m of college_edges.json, linear between rows; d = signed distance from the edge, + toward the bank (nb: d = offset - nb_inner; sb: d = sb_inner - offset)
method.rows: [from file] v1176-1440, the rows step 3 authored its barrier on (STEP-DESIGN.md)
method.returns: [measured] D24 class 1 (all non-ground in D24), not withheld; height over a TIN of the corridor's class-2 returns (the local ground under each return, steep bank included)
method.window: [from the request] |d| <= 1.5 m; band 0.5-1.2 m; 'high' > 1.5 m
method.wide: [invented] d -3.0 to +4.0 m: band returns' 0.25 m lateral histogram, its peak and the share within 0.75 m of it (finds a line that sits off a misread edge)
method.spot: [invented] 'the same spot' = within 0.5 m of the bin's lateral median of band returns
method.continuity: [invented] share of 1.0 m along-line slices of the bin holding a band return at the spot
method.verdict_bin: [invented] nothing: under 15 band returns; rail-like: lateral IQR <= 0.4 m, height IQR <= 0.3 m, continuity >= 0.6, returns > 1.5 m at the spot <= 0.5 x the band's there; vegetation: the rest
method.verdict_overall: [invented] present: >= 50% of bins rail-like with a run of >= 6; absent: <= 10% rail-like and no run of 3; else cannot tell
method.ground_far: [invented] band returns more than 2.0 m from any class-2 return are counted apart (TIN spans a gap there)
method.ground_y_across_mid_row: [measured] TIN ground at d = -1 .. +1.5 m at the bin's middle row, engine y

northbound_inner_vs_design_edge.what: the same test along college_design.json's nb_inner (edges averaged over ~33 m, misreads dropped and bridged, v1297-1300 bridged): covers v1296-1300, where college_edges.json's smoothed edge reads -12.5 m against about -7.7 m
